args.command:
mainframe awm get --session "$MAINFRAME_AWM_SESSION" "$MAINFRAME_AWM_READ_KEY" > "$MAINFRAME_AWM_SCRATCH" || { printf 'MAINFRAME_AWM_MISSING_PREDECESSOR
' >&2; exit 42; }; printf '
' >> "$MAINFRAME_AWM_SCRATCH" && IFS= read -r previous < "$MAINFRAME_AWM_SCRATCH" && test -n "$previous" && : > "$MAINFRAME_AWM_SCRATCH" && next="${previous}:${MAINFRAME_AGENT_NAME}" && mainframe awm checkpoint --session "$MAINFRAME_AWM_SESSION" "$MAINFRAME_AWM_WRITE_KEY" "$next" --importance high --tags "native-awm,$MAINFRAME_AGENT_NAME" && printf 'MAINFRAME_AWM_CHAIN_OK:%s
' "$MAINFRAME_AGENT_NAME"
args.description: Run the MAINFRAME AWM chain step for Gemini.

parts.text: MAINFRAME AWM chain step completed for Gemini.
